$about: R1 — the single canonical token set for the AhaSlides design-system-for-agents. Resolved from two disagreeing sources; see TOKENS.canonical.md for the ledger.
$precedence: MEASURED component-standard contract.json (what ships) > DS EXPORT (brand/identity/palette, Brian's stated SoT) > aha-design SKILL data (rules/format). Non-canonical skill bolt-ons (Tailwind neutrals, black-alpha text) discarded.

color.$note: Solid warm-gray text (export) chosen over the skill's black-alpha-of-indigo (rgba(26,26,46,.88)) — alpha text is the dark-surface-invisible trap aha-design-antd itself warns about.

font.$note: NO Inter. The export (SoT) declares Inter a Figma-local system face, 'not a brand face, not loaded'. The skill's Inter label rule is from a different Figma frame and is overruled. Load product self-hosted (aha-design-antd).

weight.$note: 400/600 only; 700 for Display 1/2. Export's unused 500 removed (skill rule wins).

size.$note: 18 (h6) added from skill; export's size-tiny 8px is spacing, not a text role — smallest text role is 10 (skill 'tiny').

lineHeight.$note: Unitless RATIOS, not px. body 1.5 → 21px at 14 — matches the MEASURED shipped components (checkbox 21px). The export token file's px line-heights (22/28) are drift from what ships; export's --aha-lh-tight:8px is a bug, discarded.

radius.$note: MEASURED wins: default=8 (button md / input / modal), card=12. Export MISLABELS default as 6 and lg as 8 — corrected. Export's radius-64 is off-scale (audit: likely 80) — see open items.

controlHeight.$note: MEASURED wins: fields (Input/Select/DatePicker) inherit root 32 (sm 24 / lg 40); Button carries 28/36/40/52 via components.Button. Export specimen field heights (32/36/40) are drift.

breakpoints.$note: From the export README; export space.css omits 375 (internal export nit) — README value used.

openItems: encourage-button greens (#2CB268/#168C4D/#12733F) exist in export semantic.css but in NO palette scale — add green primitives + alias, or drop the 'encourage' variant. DS-owner call.
radius-64: off the 4/6/8/12/16 scale; export README documents an 80px outlier, not 64 — confirm 80 or remove.
H5/H6 line-height: skill says 1.3; confirm against any shipped h5/h6 component.
